58: export function responseOf(
59:   answer: DirectiveResponse,
60:   at: { readonly order: MessageId; readonly person: PersonId; readonly post: PostId | null; readonly role: 'relay' | 'addressee'; readonly day: number; readonly kind: string; readonly note?: number; readonly callId?: string },
61: ): OrderResponse {
62:   return {
63:     ...(at.note === undefined ? {} : { respNote: at.note }),
64:     respOrder: at.order,
65:     respPerson: at.person,
66:     respPost: at.post,
67:     respRole: at.role,
68:     respKind: at.kind,
69:     ...(at.callId === undefined ? {} : { respCallId: at.callId }),
70:     respDay: at.day,
71:     respActual: answer.actual,
72:     respDeclared: answer.declared,
73:     respWillingness: answer.willingness,
74:     respTerms: answer.contributions.map((c) => ({ respTermName: c.term, respTermAmount: c.amount })),
75:     respReasons: answer.reasons,
76:     respStated: answer.statedReasons,
77:     respConditions: answer.conditions,
78:   };
79: }
